Here is a sample Semgrep rule for the vulnerability you've provided:

```yaml
---
id: vuln-oneuptime-07bc6d4e
title: "Improper Authorization"
description: "Potential Improper Authorization due to TableAccessControl settings."
severity: WARNING
languages:
  - typescript
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2025-65966
  CWE: CWE-285
pattern: "(?i)TableAccessControl\\s*\\(\\s*{([^}]+)}"
---
```

This rule will match any usage of `TableAccessControl` in TypeScript files, regardless of the specific settings. It's a generalization of the vulnerability and doesn't depend on repository-specific names or paths. The pattern is case insensitive and looks for the string "TableAccessControl" followed by an opening parenthesis `(`. Inside this parenthesis, it will match any characters (except a closing parenthesis `}`), which forms the settings object.

Please replace the description with more specific details about the vulnerability if available.
